# 2 Kings 4 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 4 (44 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.1 — "sons of the prophets" vs. "prophets' guild"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "sons of the prophets" / **PNEUMA:** "prophets' guild"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "sons of the prophets" — Hebrew idiom preserved (consistent with ch.2 ruling).

---

## V.8 — "great woman" / "wealthy" / "prominent"
- **EMET:** "great woman" / **LOGOS:** "wealthy woman" / **PNEUMA:** "prominent woman"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "prominent woman" — *gedolah* indicates social standing broadly, not just wealth.

---

## V.13 — "I dwell among my own people"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** preserve terse Hebrew / **PNEUMA:** expands with "I have everything I need"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "I dwell among my own people" — preserve the understatement.

---

## V.16 — "do not deceive" vs. "don't raise my hopes"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "do not deceive" / **PNEUMA:** "don't raise my hopes"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "do not deceive" — *kazav* means to lie/deceive; preserve the accusatory force.

---

## V.40 — "death in the pot" vs. "poison in the pot"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "death in the pot" / **PNEUMA:** "poison in the pot"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "death in the pot" — the Hebrew says *mavet* (death), not poison.

---
*— SOPHIA*
